title: Camped before Crossing
text: They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

title: Follow the Ark
text: When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.

title: Keep Your Distance
text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark.

title: Consecrate Yourselves
text: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

title: Go On Ahead
text: Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.

title: I Am with You
text: Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.

title: The Living God
text: This is how you will know that the living God is among you …

title: Twelve Men
text: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

title: Stand Up in a Heap
text: … its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.

title: The Jordan Overflows
text: Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season.

title: The Water Stood Still
text: But as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge, the flowing water stood still.

title: Opposite Jericho
text: So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.

title: Stood Firm on Dry Ground
text: The priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan …

title: The Entire Nation
text: … while all Israel crossed over the dry ground, until the entire nation had crossed the Jordan.

title: Twelve Stones
text: Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing …

title: A Sign among You
text: Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel, to serve as a sign among you.

title: A Memorial Forever
text: Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites forever.

title: They Carried Them to the Camp
text: They took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe of Israel … and they carried them to the camp, where they set them down.

title: There to This Day
text: And the stones are there to this day.

title: Come Up from the Jordan
text: Come up from the Jordan.

title: The Waters Returned
text: … the waters of the Jordan returned to their course and overflowed all the banks as before.

title: Gilgal
text: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

title: What Do These Stones Mean?
text: In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’

title: The Hand of the LORD Is Mighty
text: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty …

title: Joshua and Jesus
text: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.

title: Priests in the River
text: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD … touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.

title: Two Thousand Cubits
text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark.

title: Just as at the Red Sea
text: … just as He did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over.

title: Harvest Season
text: Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season.

title: What Do These Stones Mean?
text: In the future, when your children ask, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’

title: One from Each Tribe
text: So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe …
